annotation.title_clean: Tanggungjawab Perubatan dalam Pembedahan yang Dibantu Robot Menurut Perspektif Etika Islam dan Fiqh
annotation.title_en: Medical Responsibility in Robot-Assisted Surgery from Islamic Ethical and Fiqh Perspectives
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Yunos, A.S.; Wan Saifuddin, W.M.S.; Hamdan, M.N.; Baharudin, M.H.
annotation.summary_en: Malay-language journal article analysing medical responsibility in robot-assisted surgery through Islamic ethics and fiqh (ḍamān, taʿzīr, qiṣāṣ). It allocates ethical, criminal and contractual liability among surgeons, medical teams, manufacturers, hospitals and maintenance engineers, proposing a Shariah-compliant accountability model.
key_provisions_or_claims: Medical responsibility in robotic surgery is legal liability in the form of qiṣāṣ, taʿzīr or ḍamān.
Liability is divided into ethical, criminal and contractual categories.
Responsibility is shared among surgeons, medical teams, manufacturers, hospitals and maintenance engineers.
Hospitals are liable for negligence in training, maintenance and supervision, and for transparent marketing.
Proposes a Shariah-compliant accountability framework to ensure justice and patient safety.
